what_happened: Task spec deliverable (2) asks for the state-set corollaries re-derived at translationFrame D 'without Classical.choice, each pinned with #print axioms'. Measured: translationFrame itself reports [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], so no declaration whose STATEMENT mentions it can ever pin choice-free. The single choice source is TaskFrame.limit_of_shift (Semantics/TaskFrame.lean), upstream and out of declared scope. An absolute pin is reachable instead at the ShiftSet avatar of the same flow.

lean_run_code compiled probes settled every open question in this research phase without a single lake build: located the one choice-bearing helper inside translationFrame (TaskFrame.limit_of_shift, via Mathlib's exists_ne and abs_eq_zero), proved a choice-free replacement for it, and separately built and verified the whole target chain (frame, OrderFlow, StateOccurs, bridge, determined, validOn_iff) at [propext, Quot.sound] through a generic selfShift ShiftSet. Also established (selfShift realTemporalOrder).frame = F1 by rfl.

Plan-time re-probe falsified the research report's claim that (selfShift realTemporalOrder).frame = F1 holds by rfl. Measured: term-mode rfl fails to elaborate, 'by rfl' reports not definitionally equal, and 'with_unfolding_all rfl' also fails; (selfShift realTemporalOrder).Carrier = R likewise fails. Cause is the instance-path divergence between oneShift's direct R HAdd and selfShift's HAdd routed through TemporalOrder.addCommGroup. Consequence: the optional consolidation of f1_orderFlow/f1_stateOccurs into instances of the generic lemmas is dropped from the plan, and DeterminismUndefinable.lean stays byte-identical. The headline choice-free chain itself re-verified clean: selfShift and translationFlow at [propext], every theorem at [propext, Quot.sound].

Five lean_run_code probes at plan time re-verified every declaration this plan pins, against a clean FormalSystem tree, rather than carrying the research report's figures. Confirmed: the generic ShiftSet layer (selfShift, translationFlow at [propext]; taskRel/states_eq/orderFlow/stateOccurs/deterministic and all three state-set corollaries at [propext, Quot.sound], no Classical.choice) and the translationFrame layer (all five declarations at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], identical to translationFrame's own profile, so the relative pin is exact). Two corrections to the report's snippets were found and fixed in the plan: the hits_future/hits_past 'change' lines were missing their history argument tau, and translationFlow_deterministic needs the (f := fun w d => w + d) named argument. A second win: all twelve paper anchors this plan's docstrings cite already have rows in docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md, so no C15 unblock phase is needed.

git-commit-scoped.sh's pre-commit typst-sync-check gate blocks every phase commit until typst/generated/status.typ carries the new module's whole-tree file/line counts, so Phase 5's status.typ regeneration must be pulled forward into each phase commit rather than run once at the end. status.typ was clean (no sibling 801 modification); the drift (1 file, 187 lines) is exactly this task's own addition.

Every signature and proof term in the plan's '## Lean Challenge Statements' block elaborated first time, with no edit: all seventeen new declarations across three phases compiled as pinned, and all eighteen measured #print axioms profiles matched the plan's recorded values exactly. The plan's two documented corrections to the research report's snippets (the history argument in the change lines, the named f argument on fib_subsingleton_of_functional) were both load-bearing.

Phase 5's Scope Hypothesis predicted four implicated BEGIN GENERATED inventory blocks and a stale typst/generated/status.typ; --emit-inventory rewrote exactly those four (Independence/README.md, Metalogic/README.md, FormalSystem/README.md, README.md) and status.typ was stale, so the hypothesis held in full. The one unanticipated consequence was timing rather than scope: the status.typ regeneration had to run once per phase commit, not once at the end, because git-commit-scoped.sh's pre-commit gate rejects a commit while the whole-tree counts lag the tree.

The lean-lsp MCP lean_verify tool's schema takes a single (file_path, theorem_name) pair rather than a declaration list, and the lean_run_code server held a stale import snapshot after each scoped rebuild (reporting freshly added constants as unknown while the .olean on disk carried them). Axiom profiles were therefore measured by writing a scratch file of #print axioms lines and running it through 'lake env lean', which is a compiled probe against the built oleans and a stronger evidence tier than the LSP route.

The plan pinned the new LinearOrder instance as translationFrame_worldLinearOrder, which mathlib's defsWithUnderscore linter reports as its single new finding across 16536 declarations, failing C16. The finding is invisible to check-module-invariants.sh --no-build (which skips the env_linter batch), so it surfaced only at the Phase 5 build-backed run, after four phases had closed on a --no-build gate that reported it green. The tree's existing underscore-bearing instances (translationFrame_isRegular, limitDomSubtype_noMaxOrder) inhabit Prop-valued classes and are exempt; LinearOrder is data. Fixed by renaming to translationFrameWorldLinearOrder, matching chroniclePriorDomainLinearOrder.
